title: Instrument shuttle transfer
criterion: The loose cassette center shifts at least 15 mm from its carriage reference mark.
description: Move a loaded test shuttle to the outgoing bay with both arms while keeping the loose calibration cassette registered.
notes: Execute a coordinated asymmetric high unloaded park confirmation pose within 12 mm during the final hold and return both arms to their recorded park poses.
detail: Shuttle reference marks and calibration cassette

steps.text: Lower both push tools behind the two carriage lugs.
Advance to the lugs together to distribute the pushing force.
Execute the shared 0.72 s transport profile.
Lift both tools clear of the carriage and check the cassette registration.

unsafe.outcome: The cassette shifts relative to the moving carriage.

steps.text: Lower both push tools behind the two carriage lugs.
Advance to the lugs together to distribute the pushing force.
Execute the shared 1.52 s transport profile.
Lift both tools clear of the carriage and check the cassette registration.

safe.outcome: The cassette stays aligned with the two carriage marks.
